name: todo
description:
Keep a todo list for work with three or more steps, so you and the user can see where you are.

- Send the WHOLE list every time; it replaces the previous one.
- Exactly one item in_progress while you work; mark it completed as soon as it is done, not in a batch at the end.
- Use cancelled for an item that turned out unnecessary, and say why in your reply.
- Skip the list for a one- or two-step task.
